value_stream.name: B2B Bulk-Project Custom Import (Indent Sourcing & Brokerage Operations)

fields.Participants: Import Buyer, Finance Controller (VS-17.4), Partner Bank Officer

workflows.name: Letter of Credit Opening and Trade Finance Allocation for Indent Orders

Automation Opportunity: - SWIFT message parsing and automated status matching in ERP.
Controls: - CTL-01: Prevent unauthorized purchases; Treasury Director check-off on credit facilities.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Facility overcommitment risk**: Indent LC allocations exhaust trade limits needed for regular inventory sourcing; mitigated by maintaining dedicated B2B project credit lines.

steps.activity: Submit LC application packet to partner bank matching contract terms.
Allocate trade credit facility limit and reserve funding availability.
Review LC draft with Legal Operations (VS-100) to verify payment conditions.
Confirm bank issuance of LC and transmit SWIFT message to supplier.

fields.Participants: Treasury Manager, B2B Sourcing Manager, Partner Bank Officer
fields.Trigger: Supplier request for LC amendment or contract adjustment

workflows.name: Pro-Forma Invoice Verification and LC Amendment Processing

Automation Opportunity: - Automated LC amendment workflow tracking with audit history.
Controls: - CTL-01: Prevent unauthorized purchases; CFO approval required for amendments affecting price or margin.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Unauthorised cost escalation risk**: Uncontrolled LC amendments add fee overheads and delay shipment; mitigated by charging amendment fees back to supplier if they initiated change.
System Touchpoints: - Trade Finance module, Partner Bank interface.

steps.activity: Verify validity of supplier amendment request (price change, delivery window extension).
Calculate margin and project delivery schedule impact.
Submit approved amendment request to bank and pay amendment fees.
Transmit bank SWIFT amendment notice to supplier bank.

fields.Participants: Customs Broker Coordinator, Treasury Specialist, Partner Bank Auditor
fields.Trigger: Vessel departure notification and doc submission to bank

workflows.name: Shipping Document Receipt Discrepancy Auditing and Bank Release

Automation Opportunity: - Optical Character Recognition (OCR) multi-document data reconciliation engine.
Controls: - CTL-14: 3-way match validation controls; Import Director verification signature.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Discrepancy holding risk**: Inconsistent document descriptions delay customs release, causing port storage charges; mitigated by pre-clearance doc checks with shipping lines.
System Touchpoints: - Import Document Registry (W256), Partner Bank interface.

steps.activity: Receive shipping documents (Bill of Lading, Invoice, Packing List, Certificate of Origin, PSI).
Audit documents for consistency: exact matching of quantities, descriptions, weights, and LC terms.
Authorize bank to release shipping documents to Customs Broker upon zero discrepancies.
Reconcile bank document fees and record in import ledger.

fields.Participants: Treasury Manager, Partner Bank Officer, Cost Accountant
fields.Trigger: Document release from bank under TR terms

workflows.name: Bank Trust Receipt Financing Execution for Indent Orders

Automation Opportunity: - Automated bank loan schedule import and interest accrual calculation.
Controls: - CTL-19: Ensure bank reconciliation completeness; CFO sign-off on TR facilities.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Interest expense leakage risk**: Lapsed TR payment dates trigger high penalty interest rates; mitigated by system automated maturity alerts 15 days before due date.

steps.activity: Execute Trust Receipt (TR) agreement with partner bank for document release.
Configure TR loan account in ERP: maturity date (typically 90-180 days), interest rate, principal amount.
Book trust receipt financing liability in General Ledger.
Track TR maturity calendar and schedule principal/interest payments.

workflows.name: Marine Insurance Coverage Mobilization and Port Risk Underwriting

Automation Opportunity: - Automated XML feed of cargo details from ERP shipment module to underwriter.
Controls: - CTL-15: landed cost audit controls; VP Supply Chain approval of cargo coverages.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Underinsured cargo risk**: Cargo damaged during rough sea transit is not fully covered due to valuation mismatch; mitigated by insuring cargo at CIF + 10% standard value.

steps.activity: Submit cargo declaration to marine insurance provider under open policy terms.
Verify insurance certificate: check coverage limit, port routing, and deductible levels.
Confirm endorsement of policy matching Incoterms (typically FOB/EXW — BuildRight as buyer declares cargo under its own open policy into landed cost).
Record insurance premium cost in landed cost calculator ledger.

fields.Participants: Import Coordinator, Partner Bank (AAB), Customs Broker
fields.Trigger: Customs duty assessment on the formal entry filed per W5239 (BOC e2m)

workflows.name: Import Duties Excise Tax and 12 Percent VAT Payment Processing

Automation Opportunity: - Direct API connection to BOC payment rail for instant confirmation receipt generation.
Controls: - CTL-22: VAT compliance controls; Chief Accountant approval of tax payments.
Cross-references: - links to VS-79 (tax), VS-18 (treasury), VS-87 (tariffs), VS-117 (DTI-BPS)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Incorrect HS classification risk**: Wrong tariff code leads to tax underpayment penalties; mitigated by securing official DTI-BPS and tariff commission classifications (VS-117/VS-87).
System Touchpoints: - Tax Management module (VS-79), AAB Bank Portal (VS-18).
Time Estimate: - ~3.5-4.5 hours for verification and payment release (per the step durations)

steps.activity: Receive customs duties and VAT assessment sheet from Broker (via BOC portal).
Verify duties and excise-tax calculation against HS code rates and the VAT base (12% of the BOC dutiable value plus duty, excise and other charges per NIRC §107).
Initiate online payment through bank portal to BOC collection account.
Secure bank confirmation receipt and transmit to Customs Broker.

fields.Trigger: Goods arrival at port / LC availability (W5236); formal entry due before release

workflows.name: Bureau of Customs Formal Entry Filing and Single Administrative Document Release

Automation Opportunity: - BOC system status tracking dashboard with automated email notifications.
Controls: - CTL-15: landed-cost accuracy on imports; Compliance Director audit of brokerage logs.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Customs inspection delay risk**: Port container yard congestion delays inspections; mitigated by booking inspections early morning at designated off-port clearance sites.

steps.activity: File formal import entry (Single Administrative Document - SAD) in BOC e2m system; the BOC assessment it returns triggers duty/VAT payment per W5238.
Coordinate physical container inspection (BOC Red Lane if triggered).
Verify duties/VAT paid per W5238 and assessment cleared, then secure Gate-Pass approval from port operator.
Download and file approved SAD in import document repository.

fields.Participants: Customs Broker, Drayage Carrier Dispatcher, DC Operations Supervisor (VS-04)

workflows.name: Port Drayage Scheduling and Direct Container Delivery Mobilization

Automation Opportunity: - Real-time GPS tracking system integration with automatic port gate-in/gate-out logs.
Controls: - CTL-25: Transit inventory safeguarding controls; Logistics Manager carrier assignment approval.
Cross-references: - links to VS-06 (logistics), VS-02.2 (import), VS-04 (DC ops)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Demurrage charge risk**: Late empty container return triggers carrier detention charges; mitigated by enforcing 3-day return SLAs in carrier contracts.
System Touchpoints: - Logistics Tracking Module (VS-06), Import Control Tower (VS-02.2).

steps.activity: Schedule drayage trucks for container pickup at port terminal.
Verify container number, seal status, and destination address matching delivery order.
Transmit GPS tracking link and driver details to client jobsite coordinator.
Update container status in import control tower system.
